name: FinTechNerdCon — Local
_comment: Local Supabase stack. The anon key above is the CLI's fixed demo key — identical on every local install and not a secret. For a deployed project duplicate this environment, set base_url to https://<project-ref>.supabase.co and paste that project's anon/publishable key (Project Settings → API). Never put the service_role/secret key in a Postman environment you share.
